originality.rationale: The four primary full-text and indexed comparisons do not establish a complete Nauru graph-metric Rips homotopy filtration. Eppstein’s already known toroidal graph embedding and Kawamura’s bipartite graph-square \(\pi_1\) theorem are acknowledged and not claimed as new. The contribution is an exact relative collapse with 12 verified nullhomotopic 2-cell attachments and the higher-scale torus join. Indexed mathematical literature searches for Nauru/GP(12,5)/F24A, Cayley star-transposition aliases, exact sphere multiplicities, and graph-power equivalents found no covering indexed theorem. Residual possible unindexed equivalence is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: The Nauru graph is a canonical 24-vertex cubic symmetric graph with a known toroidal embedding, but the full graph-metric Rips filtration is a separate natural invariant. Explicit 12 nullhomotopic 2-cell attachments produce nontrivial 2-dimensional homology absent from fundamental-group results, and the next threshold is an exact join of two tori with homology in degrees 3,4,5. The finite result is structurally motivated, contains full coefficient-field persistence, and has an independently reproducible integral attaching certificate; no unmotivated parameter restriction or tiny numerical gain is involved.
